disorder-name.detail: DSM-IV-TR diagnosed autism spectrum disorder cases from ABIDE.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "The current study includes the data of 571 cases with ASD who had both symptom assessments and T1 images, and 1146 controls with T1 images. The cases were diagnosed according to DSM-IV-TR at each contributing site."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange; ABIDE I and II noted in preprocessing.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The study analyzed both structural neuroimaging data and phenotypic  data  provided  by  the  Autism  Brain  Imaging  Data  Exchange (ABIDE) (Di Martino et al., 2017; Di Martino et al., 2014)." "We  had  1094  participants  in ABIDE I and 1100 participants in ABIDE II who passed the preprocessing"
